note: The Workshop gallery, in story order. Sources are the ws_*.png captures (3840 x 2160, UI scale Auto, dark theme, orange accent) from the capture script. Crop boxes and anchors are estimates from older QA captures until the real ones exist: every one marked box_todo / anchor_todo gets set from the real capture (run with --debug to see them). ws_25 (main menu) and ws_26 (mod manager) are not in the capture list yet. Build: py -I ZeDUI/tools/release/make_shots.py ZeDUI/workshop/shots/shots.json

balloons.head: Your window
balloons.text: What you carry, wear and know, all in one place

balloons.head: The world's window
balloons.text: The floor, the shelves, the car beside you: every container in reach
Your hands and hotbar ride on a belt

shots.title: Your window
shots.caption: Loot, wear, health, warmth, ID, journal and skills: one window, seven tabs.

balloons.head: Seven tabs
balloons.text: Everything about you is one click away

balloons.head: Skills
balloons.text: Every skill, its level and how close the next one is
Health and carry weight stay in the title bar on every tab

shots.title: The world's window
shots.caption: Loot, crafting, building, maps, foraging, animals, the radio and the car next to you.

balloons.head: Every container
balloons.text: One button for each container in reach

balloons.head: Roll it up
balloons.text: The loot side rolls up under the title; the map stays open
Drop items on the rolled tab to put them in that container
Tabs for everything around you

shots.title: Item cards
shots.caption: Click an item, a generator, a campfire, a farm plot or a padlock: one card says it all.

balloons.head: One card for everything
balloons.text: What it is, its numbers and what you can do with it

balloons.head: Nutrition label
balloons.text: Calories, carbs, fat and protein, laid out like a real food label
What it's made of, in a line of plain words
Condition as a dot and a plain number

balloons.head: Combat facts
balloons.text: Damage, range, swing time and knockback
What you can do sits at the bottom: equip, repair, drop

shots.title: Health
shots.caption: Your body on one tab, and exercise right beside it.

balloons.head: Body figure
balloons.text: Every wound shows where it is, and heals as you watch
Overall health, then every injury in plain words

balloons.head: Exercise
balloons.text: Squats, push-ups, burpees and curls on one panel
Set the minutes, then go

shots.title: What you wear
shots.caption: A list when you want the numbers, a doll when you want to see it.

balloons.head: Equip doll
balloons.text: Each slot is wired to the part of the body it covers
Empty slots show what could go there
Worn items show their condition under the icon
Switch between the list and the doll

shots.title: Maps
shots.caption: Read the map beside your loot or unfold it big, in three styles.

balloons.text: Survey: clean lines for planning a route
Color: woods, water and towns at a glance
Paper: the old road map from the glovebox

shots.title: Flyers on the map
shots.caption: Read a flyer once and the map remembers the place.

balloons.head: Flyer pins
balloons.text: Flyers you've read drop a pin where they point
Hover a pin for what the flyer said
Click it to read the flyer again

balloons.head: Mark it up
balloons.text: Symbols, notes and four ink colours

shots.title: Crafting
shots.caption: Kilns, forges, ovens, drying racks: Build 42's crafting, right at the station.

balloons.head: Any bench, any station
balloons.text: Recipes for your hands and every station within reach
Search and sort every recipe you know

balloons.head: Recipe card
balloons.text: What it needs, what you have, what's still missing
Craft one, or set how many

shots.title: Right-click menus
shots.caption: Pick the icon strip or the list in Options, Mods, ZeD UI.

balloons.head: Icon strip
balloons.text: Every action as an icon, with what it needs
The action's name sits over the strip

balloons.head: Or a list
balloons.text: One action to a row, like the game's own menu

balloons.head: On a controller
balloons.text: Everything you can do with a mouse, you can do with a pad
Emotes, the car and quick use, all on wheels

shots.title: The belt and the watch
shots.caption: The watch is a real item in the loot. Wear it and it rides on your belt.

balloons.head: A watch you use
balloons.text: Time, date, temperature, alarm and a stopwatch
The buttons work: set the alarm, run the stopwatch
Tucked away, it's a small watch on your belt

balloons.head: The belt
balloons.text: Your hands and hotbar in one strip, each item's condition under it

shots.title: The action bar
shots.caption: Rather not read? Options turns it into ten little lights.

balloons.head: What you're doing
balloons.text: In words, over your head: reading, moving, cooking
How far the queue has got: 3 of 6
One bar for the whole job, a notch for each item

shots.title: Driving
shots.caption: Every car gets a dashboard drawn for it, and the radio that came with it.

balloons.head: Pixel dashboard
balloons.text: Speed, fuel and engine heat, the way your car shows them
Turn the key to start

balloons.head: Car radio
balloons.text: Tune, seek and play your tapes

balloons.head: At night
balloons.text: The gauges light up like a real panel
Heat, fan and air on real buttons

shots.title: Menus and settings
shots.caption: Load, new game, mods, options, sandbox: ZeD windows, with the game's own logic underneath.

balloons.head: The desk
balloons.text: The main menu is a 1993 desk; your last save waits on the screen

balloons.head: Mod manager
balloons.text: Load order, clashes between mods and which one wins

balloons.head: Your colours
balloons.text: Theme, accent, text size and a UI scale for big screens

balloons.head: Safe mode
balloons.text: If ZeD ever fails to open, the game's own screens come back
The watch sits in the corner, the time at a glance
Moodles stay the game's own, where you want them
Hands, hotbar and buckle on one belt
Your bags on one side, the cupboards on the other
The bar over your head counts the queue down
